description: Record a conversation turn, observation, thought trace, or reasoning experience into Evermind cognitive memory.

async_mode.description: Whether memory extraction should process asynchronously in background (default: true)

content.description: Text content of the message or observation (shorthand for single turn)

messages.description: Batch of structured messages to record into episodic memory

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond or second timestamp (defaults to current time)

sender_id.description: Identifier of the sender (defaults to authenticated caller username)

session_id.description: Session or thread identifier for grouping episodic turns. Defaults to an agent-scoped session

timestamp.description: Optional unix millisecond or second timestamp for single-turn shorthand

name: lokha_memory_add
